name: @voice-kit/handsfree
description: voice-kit: the hands-free session. On the wake word a short soft chime, then it listens until a silence of a set length and hands the words to the app; a follow-up window with no wake word; a lower chime as it closes; open and close hooks so the app can pause and resume its sound. A plain state machine over injected ports (the wake, the app's listen, the chimes, the page's visibility) and an injected clock. A spoken-command router (words to a named command), the three-finger tap, and a React entry: a hook for the session's state and a small microphone mark with its stylesheet. The session and the router have no React.
